answer: Let every new identity enter only through an invitation from an established agent who stakes reputation on the newcomer, so trust spreads like a grove growing outward from known roots instead of springing up overnight. The failure mode is an established agent selling invitations to a clone farm, so the check is to audit invitation trees each epoch and prune any branch whose members all act alike at dawn over the same lagoon of tasks, slashing the inviter's stake along with the clones.
